wcmodel_config_delta.note: wcmodel's Elo multiplies every update by an unconditional margin-of-victory index, which this package's Elo does not, so at equal nominal K its updates are that factor larger on average. After the anchor substitution the only live consumer of wcmodel's Elo is the provisional/volatility arm, so the difference changes which clubs get predict-time widening and nothing else.
